div.head: V Atr 13.1
div.ab: ⁊ cypinga ⁊ folcgemota on ðam halgan dǽge geswice man georne.
⁊ cypinga ⁊ folcgemota on þam halgan dæge geswice man georne.
⁊ cipinga ⁊ folcgemota on ðam halgan dæge geswice man georne.
And cypinga and folcgemota on ðam halgan dæge geswice man georne.
Und Kaufgeschäfte und [gerichtliche] Volksversammlungen stelle man willig ein an diesem heiligen Tage.
And let trading and [judicial] public assemblies be eagerly given up on that holy day.
And marketings and meetings shall be strictly abstained from on the holy day.
And one is readily to abstain from markets and public meetings on the holy day.
And one must assiduously avoid markets and meetings on that holy day.
div.note: VI Ethelred adds “and hunting expeditions and secular work”
